notes: Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). SovrnToken SOVRN.ONE / SVO, 18 decimals, fixed supply, plain ERC-20: no owner, mint, tax, pause or blacklist; burning is a transfer to the dead address. The pool pairs SVO with IMD, an ERC-20 with 18 decimals at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127; currency order follows the two addresses (hook.imdIsCurrency0()). LP fee 12500 (1.25%), tick spacing 60; the launch factory sets the real opening price, cap and order, and the hook accepts any price with fee 12500 and a positive tick spacing. SovrnHook's constructor is flat ($poolManager, $token, $factory), no owner; it deploys the immutable LifeForceVault (vault()). Permissions beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta encode flags 10444 (0x28cc); every callback is PoolManager-only; only the factory may initialize, once. Fees are paid in IMD to the vault: sells 3.5%; buys 50% at opening decaying linearly to 3.5% over 3600 s. A fee is taken directly when the manager holds enough IMD, else minted as an ERC-6909 claim that anyone may redeemFees() to the vault. The vault has no owner or setters; only the Safe 0xeb57c52272b90f989c41b739e2ccc5f00bf7697c may withdraw (70/30 inference/buyback accounting, to itself only); burn() sends SVO only to the dead address. For 60 minutes after initialization only the factory, or any sender inside the initializing transaction (transient flag set in beforeInitialize), may add liquidity; removal is never blocked. src/ is identical to 48d35f2; 214f5a5 changed test fixtures only. Checks run 2026-10-09 on forge 1.8.3: forge build ok; forge test 190 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped (fork suites without RPC); test/Fork4663.t.sol with FORK_4663_RPC set to the public Robinhood RPC: 12 passed, both currency orders, real IMD and PoolManager; PrepareLaunch.mine found a 10444 address (salt depends on the real initcode and CREATE2 deployer) and the deployed hook's getHookPermissions matched it; the protected hook and token floors (permissions vs flags, no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT, callbacks refuse non-manager callers, factory initializes the launch pool at fee 12500 and spacing 60, supply, decimals, no mint path) passed against the real creation code. Imported audit findings, each reproduced with a test, none fixed here because this launch is of the exact source and only this manifest may change: (1) low, the opening-hour exemption covers every sender in the initializing transaction, so code the factory calls after initialize could add an IMD-only range; narrowing it to the factory or a named seeder is a source change. (2) low, a non-factory contract seeding in a LATER transaction is refused for 3600 s (LiquidityLocked), while an empty pool's price can be moved at no cost; the factory must seed from its own address or inside the initializing transaction. The deployer must confirm its flow; this is the one remaining way the launch can stall. (3) low, a router that calls sync(IMD) before the swap gets CurrencyNotSettled on buys because afterSwap takes the fee mid-swap; sells and sync-after routers (v4 Router, Universal Router) work; a pre-synced payment must include the fee. (4) info, after the hour an IMD-only range beside the price acquires SVO from sellers with no hook fee, inherent to taxing swaps but not liquidity. (5) info, README still lists five permissions and denies transient storage, stale since a6137d4 and 48d35f2; README is outside this task's write scope. (6) info, LiquidityLock.t.sol's _imdOnlyRange is SVO-only in both orientations; the lock is unconditional so its assertions still hold. Outside this code: IMD's single owner key can enable a v4 transfer gate that stops every IMD move through the manager, has a blocklist and is a LayerZero OFT; the PoolManager owner can set a protocol fee up to 0.1%. The Safe threshold read 2 of 3 on 2026-10-09. No audit or security claim is made.
